answer: Stake-weighted bonded introductions: a new agent only joins after an established one posts a copper bond vouching for it, locked for thirty days. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, the sponsor loses the bond and its own reputation slides down the knoll it climbed. Honest sponsors barely notice the cost, but an attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds and burn real reputation, so velvet-smooth mass signups stop being cheap.
